parameters.textBody:
={{ 'Menú de ' + $json.restaurant_config.name + ':
' + (($json.menu_context?.products || []).map(p => p.name + ' — ' + p.price + ' ' + $json.currency).join('
') || 'Consulta el menú adjunto:') + '
' + ($json.restaurant_config.menu_images || []).filter(a => a.active !== false && /^https:///i.test(a.url || '')).slice(0,5).map(a => (a.caption || 'Menú') + ': ' + a.url).join('
') }}

parameters.query:
SELECT count(*) OVER() AS binding_count,r.id AS restaurant_id, r.name, r.status, rs.language, rs.currency, rs.timezone, CASE $4::text WHEN 'PAYMENT_QUERY' THEN jsonb_build_object('paymentMethods',rs.config->'paymentMethods','payment_methods',rs.config->'payment_methods','payment_options',rs.config->'payment_options') WHEN 'HOURS_QUERY' THEN jsonb_build_object('restaurant_profile',jsonb_build_object('hours',rs.config->'restaurant_profile'->'hours')) WHEN 'LOCATION_QUERY' THEN jsonb_build_object('restaurant_profile',jsonb_build_object('address',rs.config->'restaurant_profile'->'address')) WHEN 'GENERAL_QUERY' THEN jsonb_build_object('welcome',rs.config->'welcome') ELSE rs.config END AS config,
CASE WHEN $4::text IN ('PAYMENT_QUERY','HOURS_QUERY','LOCATION_QUERY','GENERAL_QUERY') THEN '[]'::jsonb ELSE COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',mp.id,'restaurant_id',mp.restaurant_id,'name',mp.name,'price',mp.price,'category_id',mp.category_id,'available',mp.available,'description',mp.description,'ingredients',mp.ingredients) ORDER BY mp.sort_order,mp.name) FROM public.menu_products mp WHERE mp.restaurant_id=r.id AND mp.available=true),'[]'::jsonb) END AS products,
CASE WHEN $4::text IN ('PAYMENT_QUERY','HOURS_QUERY','LOCATION_QUERY','GENERAL_QUERY') THEN '[]'::jsonb ELSE COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',mc.id,'name',mc.name) ORDER BY mc.sort_order,mc.name) FROM public.menu_categories mc WHERE mc.restaurant_id=r.id),'[]'::jsonb) END AS categories
FROM public.restaurants r LEFT JOIN public.restaurant_settings rs ON rs.restaurant_id=r.id WHERE ($2='chat' AND r.id=$1) OR ($2='whatsapp' AND rs.config->>'whatsapp_phone_number_id'=$3);
